title: Expression temporary belongs to the temporary set
statement: Let $F,k\in\bbn$ and let $e$ be an expression built from natural-number constants and variables, binary addition, subtraction, or multiplication, and loads. If $k+\mathrm{height}(e)\le 2F+1$, then the temporary address $-(23+4k)$ belongs to the set consisting of the address $-13$ and all addresses $-(23+4j)$ with $k\le j\le 2F$.
